description: The line plot illustrates the BLEU score differences between training and testing contexts in simultaneous machine translation, comparing consistency and inconsistency in wait times. The x-axis represents the length of the gold prefix, ranging from 0 to 20, with a tick label interval of 5. The y-axis measures the BLEU score, ranging from 23 to 29, with a tick label interval of 1. The blue line, marked with circles and a dashed line style, represents the consistency with a wait time of 1, showing a general upward trend in BLEU score as the length of the gold prefix increases. The red line, marked with squares and a solid line style, represents the inconsistency with a wait time of 9, displaying fluctuations in BLEU score across the length of the gold prefix.
